row.name: Acadian Asset Management Inc. Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=24 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=1 giveback=0.59 tightness=1.1 base_volume_vs_leg=1.04 base_volume_vs_avg=0.95
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 24 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20; the base gave back 0.59 of the leg; the base ranged wider than the sessions before it

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: base over 21 sessions: +CV applies, volume must be >= 1.5x average and a catalyst is needed, which bars cannot show

notes: extension: close 4.4% vs its 20-SMA, 3.7% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 1 of 1 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The base is 24 sessions long — outside Bonde's 3–20 window — and the chart confirms a wide, choppy consolidation from early October through the signal day, with multiple overlapping bars spanning roughly 87–97 and a giveback of 0.59 of the prior leg. The range-expansion check also fails: the burst bar at 4.7% is only 0.68× the largest of the prior five bars, meaning the signal day is not the widest bar in recent memory. These two recorded FAILs together make this a marginal setup.
claude.key_risk: The base gave back more than half the prior leg and is too long, so any follow-through is fighting a loose, extended consolidation with no clean overhead clearance.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open gaps above the signal close near 96 without a clean tight open, or if the first 30 minutes show a fade back below the prior day's close near 91.
